text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
choice_data_list: You're full of energy, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I called my family yesterday
and got some of their happy qi shared with me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I talked so much about feng shui with Papa, and Mama looked as happy as ever!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My little brother...
still doesn't seem interested in feng shui, but seeing him doing well was a relief!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The two youngest act like little queens or princesses,
begging for this and that, which seems to really trouble
my second younger sister—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Copano Rickey had a thoroughly fulfilling day off!
